node.text: Dolly Parton was one of the most gifted songwriters and talented voices. An undisputed icon. She turned a tiny Appalachian upbringing into a massive career. She put country music on the pop charts, and culturally, she built bridges like nobody else could. To the end, she was always bringing people together with that pure heart, incredible wit, and unrivaled storytelling. Rest in peace, Dolly Parton.

node.text:
Our September Bake Club recipe for Glazed Apple Fritters is designed to recreate the experience of eating hot cider donuts from the farm stand—apple-studded dough, a hint of grease, a jolt of sugar and spice—without waiting for the yeast to rise. It borrows the best bits from a cake doughnut (tender, fluffy insides) and a state fair fritter (big, juicy chunks of fruit) for a dialed-up treat that tastes like fried apple pie.

Get the recipe at bonappetit.com, then share your bakes with the Bake Club community on Substack.

🎥 @emmarj16, 🎞 @jeremykohm

Her Gohan Gooey Butter Cookies take inspiration from classic Midwestern gooey butter cake, with crisp edges, chewy centers, white chocolate, and a salty-sweet puffed rice brittle for crunch.

@jesseszewczyk recreated them in the BA Test Kitchen, and yes, they’re as good as they sound. Comment "cookie" for a DM.
